spans.s: __1 A mare; सैव भूत्वाथ वडवा नासत्यौ सुषुवे भुवि [[

.]] 
__2 The nymph Aśvinī who in the form of a mare bore to the sun two sons, the Aśvins; see संज्ञा. 
__3 A female slave. 
__4 A harlot, prostitute. 
__5 A woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste (द्विजयोषित्). 
__6 A particular constellation represented by a horse's head. 
-Comp. 
-अग्निः, -अनलः the submarine fire.
